testimonials.name: Ayisha
testimonials.quote: Absolutely loved the Aari work on my blouse! ❤️ The work was so beautiful and perfectly done. Everyone loved it and kept asking me about the designer. Already looking forward to choosing your designs for my next function! ✨ Highly recommend!

testimonials.name: Reehana
testimonials.quote: We entrusted this boutique with my daughter's wedding reception blouse as well as my own silk saree blouse, and both turned out spectacular. When wedding dates are tight, delays are a major fear. But Khadeeja and her team promised delivery in three weeks and handed over both pieces two days ahead of schedule. The quality of the raw silk fabric, the neat inner lining, the sturdy latkans, and the intricate peacock motif Aari handwork drew compliments from all our guests.It is rare to find an embroidery studio in Trichy that combines authentic traditional craftsmanship with such prompt, stress-free customer service. A genuine 10/10 recommendation for any family preparing for a wedding.

testimonials.name: Noor
testimonials.quote: I ordered a custom bridal Aari work blouse from Khadeeja Designs for my friends wedding reception, and the craftsmanship exceeded all my expectations! I paired it with a pure Kanchipuram silk saree and wanted intricate zardosi detailing with delicate beadwork on the sleeves and neckline. Khadeeja was incredibly patient throughout the consultation, we discussed design references, thread shades, and motif placement over WhatsApp, and the team brought the concept to life flawlessly. The finishing on the reverse side is neat with zero loose threads or irritation, and the fit was spot on. Everything was completed within 18 days and delivered right on schedule with secure packaging. If you are looking for authentic, handcrafted bridal embroidery in Trichy or ordering online across India, Khadeeja Designs is definitely the best boutique to trust for your big day✨🛍️.
